checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: mark truncated eval run IDs clearly. EvalsPanel renders run.id.slice(0, 18) in a run row with no ellipsis, so a shortened ID looks like a complete one. Show an ellipsis only when the ID is actually longer than the slice, keeping the full ID in the title/heading and all testids and handlers unchanged. Add a git-ignored scenario that stubs /api/evals/runs with a long ID, capture before/after at 390/1440, vision-review, then ui verify, gates and a Phase 4 checkpoint.

impact_assessment.why: The user wants a polished UI; a silently truncated ID looks like a complete value.
impact_assessment.benefits: Truncated IDs are visibly marked; full ID still available in the detail heading.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: testids, handlers and the full ID heading unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: short IDs must not get an ellipsis
impact_assessment.mitigation: Conditional ellipsis in JSX only; verify with a stubbed runs scenario, gates and a11y.
